A 15:36 UTC refresh rechecked exact PR metadata, review records, and current-head jobs for drmTMB #1662/#1663 and DRModels.jl #1237/#1240/#1245. It confirmed all four #1663 Ubuntu shards had reached R CMD check but were still active; #1245 metadata points to 0dde1f9 while its body still says the PR metadata points to 7f6e335; and no formal review was recorded for the four current PRs. Formal review remains absent. The report/check-log refresh used a fresh file-scoped preflight and live lease. The R owner checkout matches the remote PR head but has three tracked modifications and 75,585 untracked files; the Julia #1245 checkout matches its PR head but has 22 tracked modifications and 54 untracked files; the Julia primary checkout has six tracked modifications and 22 untracked files, including separate CMR material. Retrieved the bounded macOS job log for #1657; it confirms failures at lines 149 and 162 with optimizer code 1 and degenerate classification against the branch’s old assertions. Retrieved the bounded macOS job log for #1659 and confirmed the same two inherited temporal OU test failures seen on #1657. Both PR bases retain the old assertion; merged #1662 contains the shared-test correction. Refreshed seven exact-head check sets and formal review lists; no owner branches were edited. Attempted to coordinate the exact #1657/#1659 macOS failure diagnosis through GitHub issue comments; both calls returned HTTP 403 Resource not accessible by integration, and no comments were created. Recorded this communication blocker; no alternate channel or owner branch was used. Refreshed drmTMB #1529 metadata, review list, and exact-head checks because #1658 declares it as a predecessor. score_reason: The report uses exact files, SHAs, run IDs, and explicit limits. Some technical sentences are dense, but the PR status is separated into short bullets.

No current-pair parity or interval calibration is inferred. Current 15:36 UTC PR metadata, exact-head workflow/job records, review queries, and scoped report lease were rechecked. The #1663 source-tree and Ubuntu jobs remain queued; no result is inferred. The final report/check-log edits passed the closeout compiler, after-task structure check, prose lint with zero findings, exact SHA-256 match, and git diff check. The manifest mismatch attribution is based on exact GitHub file reads at current main and the current PR head. The separate linter findings remain unverified, and the four Ubuntu release shards have no terminal result. The 16:10 UTC update is supported by direct current PR metadata, exact-head CI diagnostics and job-step state, and formal-review queries. The #1663 package-check result remains pending. The 16:18 UTC status is based on current PR metadata, the exact commit comparison and file contents, exact workflow job states for both heads, and the current formal-review list. The new head has no test outcome yet. The additional worktree counts are direct `git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all` summaries at the recorded exact paths; remote topic heads were compared read-only. No files were cleaned, staged, or changed in those owner worktrees.

PR #1237 run 41401878711 fails in two files outside its one-file diff; no cause was assigned. Open-PR results are recorded as search counts, not completeness or parity measures. The focused #1657 exact-head archive test was run directly and exited 0 on R 4.6.0/macOS arm64; the new offline assertion ran, while both live Julia fit tests skipped. The process output was not retained as a raw file and this limit is recorded. No formal reviews were returned for these six PRs. The crosswalk report was updated without modifying the overlapping capability page or dirty owner worktree. The source-tree job failed two reader-vignette contract expectations, and all four Ubuntu package-check shards were still active. No cause was inferred for the two linter findings; the active SD lane retains the manifest and vignette work. At 15:22 UTC, GitHub showed PR #1663 at b718863e7319af143896614e823d44e488be0653 with no formal review; run 41466710037 on the prior head was cancelled, and replacement run 41470627997 was queued. Its result remains unknown. At 16:10 UTC, GitHub current-head metadata, exact-head workflow checks/jobs, and formal review lists were read directly for the four named PRs. The #1663 run remained active with all four Ubuntu check-r-package steps in progress; no package-check result is claimed. #1245 current metadata and CI are distinguished from the stale head statement in its PR body. #1237 and #1240 failures remain as recorded by exact-head workflow results. No claim about broad parity or scientific calibration is added. At 16:18 UTC, exact PR metadata and commit comparison showed #1663 advanced by one commit.
